senses.gloss:
m. (-लः)
1 Swinging.
2 A festival on the 14th of Phalguna, the swinging of the juvenile KṚṢṆA.
mf. (-लः-ला or ली)
1 A litter, a swinging cot, a dooly.
2 A swing.
f. (-ला)
The indigo plant.
E.
दुल to throw up or toss, to swing, affix अच्; fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Swinging, being swung.
2 Doubting, perplexed, vacillating.
E.
दुल to swing, causal form, शानच् aff.

f. (-का)
A swing.
E.
कन् added to दोली.
